figures.title: Neurocysticercosis MRI findings
figures.alt: MRI brain images. A, B, C: T2/FLAIR show racemose neurocysticercosis in basal cisterns. D, E: T1 post-contrast show parenchymal cysts/granulomas. F: T2 shows hydrocephalus.
